rationale: Jonathan brings hands-on ML expertise across NLP, robotics manipulation, and data pipelines with a strong Python/PyTorch foundation, while Matt leads AI infrastructure initiatives at the Linux Foundation and teaches at UC Berkeley—creating a natural mentorship and knowledge-exchange dynamic. Both work in Python-centered ML ecosystems, and Matt's focus on agentic AI and ML infrastructure directly complements Jonathan's applied research interests, offering opportunities for Jonathan to learn production-scale AI systems while potentially informing Matt's work with current graduate-level ML perspectives.
intro_message: Jonathan Chong, meet Matt White — a Global CTO of AI at the Linux Foundation who can offer deep insight into scaling ML systems and agentic AI, areas that align well with your robotics and NLP work.
